title: Watch your cashflow, revenue pulled in
heading: Watch your cashflow
caption: The same million, one month earlier. The company lives.

board.label: Cashflow board, January to April, the revenue one month earlier

predicted-revenue-is-discounted.description: Investors discount revenue that is only predicted, and founders who count on raising more money often find that assumption false, so projected revenue does not cover present costs.[1]

default-alive.title: Paul Graham, Default Alive or Default Dead?

callback.title: Callback
callback.script: Second time on this board. Same notes, same costs, and one thing has moved.

timing-not-amount.title: Timing, not amount
timing-not-amount.script: The amount did not change, one month did. The company lives. The same million, a month earlier, and that is the whole difference between a company and a story.

how-it-moves.title: How it moves
how-it-moves.script: Now, how does a note move? A deal lands earlier only if the first call came earlier. So build your own month-by-month board, find your zero-cash month, and count back from it.
